verdict_reasoning: A real idea, but the statement half duplicates category/merchant/trend analytics that the Revolut app already provides from the same export, and the receipt line-item half - the genuinely novel part - has no input data, a duplicated parser and a demo API key. No human has committed since 2026-05-30; the previous review's REVIVE and its one unblocking fixture produced no follow-through in seven weeks. Worth starting only when there is a recurring need for item-level spend data that Revolut cannot answer, plus real receipt photos and a working OCR path committed as fixtures.
next_review_note: Set per routine, but a parked repo does not merit a full review in 10 days - recommend demoting BudgetSorter out of the daily rotation instead.
